static_traits.name: 杜若曦
static_traits.family_status: Living alone，住在带院子的房子里
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可倾诉，但近期主动疏远，且难以向朋友敞开心扉表达内疚与not自足
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；not yet曾接受心理治疗；without类似问题史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑连贯，Neutral attitude；能配合探索但情绪负担较重，倾向自我责备；对与朋友谈及感受感到困难

basic_info.main_problem: 自从爱犬近期去世以来，我一直感到not完整并被内疚压倒。我觉得自己是个糟糕的主人，这影响了我的心理健康和创作力。
basic_info.core_demands: 因压倒性的内疚和not够好的感受影响了我进行艺术创作与在日常活动中获得喜悦，所以寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 近期爱犬去世后，来访者持续陷入强烈内疚与自责，认为自己在照料方面失败（如可能have not及时就医、忽略病兆）。该事件引发Low mood、创作受阻、社交疏离与日常自我照料的混乱，并在家中被与爱犬相关的提醒物反复trigger。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / I will fail

special_situations.event: At home, sees reminders related to the beloved dog (such as toys, collar, yard)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my dog dies, it means I have completely failed as an owner
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing、用散步和艺术项目分散注意力以减轻内疚
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault；我是个糟糕的主人

special_situations.event: 回想自己可能have not及时带狗去看Veterinarian或错过病兆
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not做到完美的照料，那就等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterwards repeatedly self-blames harshly and tries to find in the mind 'where did I go wrong'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该更早带他去看Doctor；如果我做得更多，他就not会死

special_situations.event: 进行艺术创作或处理日常事务时想到自己“have not照顾好狗”
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failing in one important matter means I will also fail in other aspects
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops or reduces creating; keeps distance from friends to avoid further feelings of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在其他方面也not行；我作为Artist也是失败的

special_situations.event: Recalling happy moments spent with the beloved dog (walking, playing in the yard, greeting at homecoming)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only if the ending is good do the previous effort and giving count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正向记忆与证据，持续聚焦负面细节与结局
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些好的都not算，因为他已经走了

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被理解、被认可并被原谅（作为尽责的主人与Artist）
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被指责与被negate，害怕确认自己是失败者
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control over events through self-blame
与他人保持距离以避免被评判或negate

object_relations.self_representation: 负罪的失败者、not称职的照顾者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人（朋友/旁人）是not理解、可能negate她的人
世界/工作像苛刻的考官，要求完美without误

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the cause of the dog's death or seeing reminders related to the beloved dog at home
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人会认为It is all my fault，我必须承担全部责任（移情：自我贬损）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责性语言，主动承认过错，贬低自我价值；语气低沉，减少与他人互动与眼神接触。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about confiding in a friend or preparing to meet a friend
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: They will not understand me，会轻视或negate我的感受（移情：将批判性的他人形象Projection到朋友身上）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoids socializing、延迟见面或简短回应；用谨慎甚至Self-denial的用词表达“我not该麻烦do not人”。

manifestations: The beloved dog's recent death triggers persistent guilt and self-blame
将Death的发生归因于自身失败
Difficulty opening up to friends about guilt
Artistic creation affected by emotional distress
Difficulty finding joy in daily activities
outcomes: 体验到not完整与失去意义感

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出某个行为的冲动，或放弃向外寻求do not人为其做某事，转而对自己做（将能量由外Turning against the self）。
manifestations: Has the urge to express and seek help but finds it hard to speak to friends
把应向外表达的情绪转为自我苛责与自我Repression

contact_model.definition: 存在not良的自我Reflection与自我限制，包含过多的自我苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎。
manifestations: 过度自我批评（“I am not good enough/我是糟糕的主人”）
Cautious about socializing and expression, worries about being taken lightly

contact_model.definition: Deliberately avoids a certain stimulus from the internal or external environment, avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Distracts attention with walks or art projects to avoid core sadness and guilt
When talking about positive memories, quickly returns to negative conclusions, avoiding dwelling on feelings

exception_events.target_problem: 在家中被与爱犬相关的提醒trigger时，杜若曦通常会陷入强烈自责与内疚，难以专注创作或完成日常事务。
exception_events.unique_outcome: When starting a completely new painting, Du Ruoxi can briefly focus, the sense of guilt relatively weakens, and emotion is more stable.
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同做法——将注意力转向具体创作任务；not同情境——新主题的绘画减少与爱犬的直接联想，因此出现了短暂的情绪缓和与专注。

exception_events.target_problem: 沉浸在负面记忆与自我指责中时，杜若曦通常被内疚淹not，难以平衡看待自己曾经的付出。
exception_events.unique_outcome: When recalling fragments of her beloved dog greeting her or playing in the yard, Du Ruoxi felt warmth and smiled, her guilt eased and she could briefly experience good feelings.
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同理解——将注意力转向真实的正向照料证据与美好回忆，从而在当下获得更平衡的情绪体验。

positive_force: Has sustained artistic creative ability and interest
There are many real positive care memories and evidence (walks, quality diet, companionship)
Willing to seek help and try to understand events from a more objective view
Has a few contactable friends as potential support
negative_force: negate正向经历与证据的认知偏差
Social avoidance导致支持减少与Loneliness加重
将事件完全个人化承担责任，Reinforcement失败自我图式

antecedent: Seeing reminders of the beloved dog at home
Recalls care details (such as medical visit times, symptoms)
target_behavior.core_reason: 将爱犬Death完全归因于自身失败的核心信念与认知歪曲（如All-or-Nothing Thinking、Personalization、Disqualifying the Positive）
target_behavior.function: 通过自责维持一种“可控/赎罪”的感受，回避面对偶然性与not确定性带来的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 艺术创作受阻、日常自我照料紊乱、情绪持续低落与Intensified sense of isolation

antecedent: Receiving invitations or contact from friends
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被误解或轻视（Mind Reading倾向）、Lowered sense of self-worth与羞愧感
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的negate或评判以降低Anxiety与羞愧
target_behavior.consequence: 支持系统削弱、Loneliness感增加、负性信念得以维持
